description:
We are F4NTASTIC, a team of four enthusiastic students from Curtin University Malaysia, brought together by our shared passion for innovation, technology, and creative problem-solving. As participants in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, we are excited to challenge ourselves, explore new ideas, and push beyond the boundaries of what we thought was possible.

Our team is taking on the challenge of developing health monitoring software designed to support astronauts during long-duration space missions. With the unique physical and psychological challenges that come with space exploration, we aim to create an innovative, practical, and user-friendly solution that empowers astronauts to better understand, monitor, and manage their health and well-being.

We believe that great ideas come from collaboration, diverse perspectives, and the courage to think differently. By combining our individual strengths, creativity, and determination, we hope to transform our ideas into something meaningful that could contribute to the future of human space exploration.

For us, this challenge is more than just a competition. It is an opportunity to learn, grow, collaborate, and turn our curiosity into real-world solutions. We may be a team of four students, but we believe that with passion, teamwork, and a little bit of imagination, even the smallest ideas can lead to extraordinary possibilities.
